payload.text: Doom/MELPA stale clone (kovacs-sysadm's report, 9 Nov, FYI): MELPA renamed master to main and deleted master, so a single-branch straight clone whose fetch refspec is hard-wired to master fails 'doom sync -u' with "couldn't find remote ref refs/heads/master". editors_maintain (liberators/editors.sh:330-364) runs that command and molt_errors on it, so molt maintain fails on any Doom sleeve still pointed at master. Repointed by hand on rhadamanth and kovacs (melpa at 9a715f54, tracking origin/main; molt maintain then rc 0, 190 packages current); gyges is likely still stale. For hv to rule: whether Molt should detect or repair a renamed upstream default branch in a straight repo, or leave it to hand. Nothing started.
